facts.business: Prima Plastics Limited is a leading manufacturer and producer of plastic furniture products, operating in a single segment of designing, producing, marketing, and supplying plastic moulded products in domestic and international markets.
key_risks: Volatility in petrochemical feedstock prices (polypropylene and polyethylene)
Intense competition from unorganized sector with low-cost imitations
Growing trend of premiumization posing substitution risk
Foreign exchange (FX) risk due to expanding global footprint
facts.related_party_note: Loan to Prima Innovation Limited (entity under common control) of Rs 1,138.78 lakhs pursuant to demerger scheme; Security deposits with related party of Rs 4.95 lakhs; Investment in subsidiaries Prima Union Plasticos S.A. (Rs 319.98 lakhs) and Prima Innovation Limited (cancelled Rs 1.00 lakh); Investment in joint venture Prima Dee-Lite Plastics SARL (Rs 102.07 lakhs).
